content.subject: Fw: Reply to your article: How the Detroit Tigers built a sinking ship over four yrs

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Bobowing@aol.com <Bobowing@aol.com>
Sent: Sunday, September 24, 2017 7:37 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Reply to your article: How the Detroit Tigers built a sinking ship over four yrs 
 
 
 
Anthony--great article. You nailed it.  We need more honest sports writers like you.  I get tired of excuses being written by fake news.  One Detroit Sports writer  has such a fake ego that he continues to show his story line photo that was taken 25 or 30 years ago before he got old and gray like the rest of us. 
 
Enjoyed your detailed analysis--best I have seen of this current Tigers mess.
 
Bob White
Detroit Sports Fan
